message: Running command: cd /workspace/poppler && git show 08572e1b^:poppler/Parser.cc | head -250 | tail -80

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The issue is that `dictLookup` can trigger XRef reconstruction (when the file is damaged), which can invalidate the `entry` pointer. After the reconstruction, the code uses `entry` which is now a dangling pointer (heap-use-after-free).

Let me look at the code before the fix to understand the context better:
